title: The Neon Brutalist Aesthetic
description: A deep dive into the design system of vibescoder.dev
content:
Neon Brutalism is all about high contrast, bold colors, and unapologetic design. We use CSS variables to maintain a consistent theme across the site.

The colors like `--color-primary` and `--color-surface` play a huge role in creating that vibe.

title: Why Search is Cool
description: Exploring the power of client-side search with Fuse.js
content:
Search is a fundamental part of user experience. By using Fuse.js, we can provide a fast and fuzzy search experience directly in the browser. This avoids extra server roundtrips and keeps things snappy.

It's particularly great for small to medium-sized datasets like blog posts.
